content:
If this is an IMAP account, you could do this:

  1. click help>troubleshootinginformation
  2. scroll to 'profile folder' and click 'open folder'
  3. exit thunderbird
  4. click imapmail\<IMAP account folder>
  5. locate the large message folder, probably inbox
  6. DELETE the inbox and inbox.msf entries
  7. restart thunderbird

creator: davidsk

content:
Hi Wayne,

Three ideas:

  • Enable split tunneling in the VPN so that Thunderbird does not use the VPN.
  • Try a more respected VPN. The VPNs that are rated best for privacy are IVPN, Proton, and Mullvad. Thunderbird has worked fine for me while I've used IVPN and Mullvad. Before I started using Thunderbird, I used Proton for a while and did not have any transmission problems in e-mail.
  • The Netgear VPN is a Bitdefender product. Are you using it with other Bitdefender products such as anti-virus? If you search the forum, you will probably find many reports of problems between Bitdefender's anti-virus product and Thunderbird.
